corrections.what: Coloured the whole ballot outline red, and the arrow from x 211.12 to its head
corrections.why: The catalogue's Red text names 'the ballot's upper/right accent edge'; the red sheet shows all four ballot edges red. The reference image controls. The arrow's black-to-red change is a square cut (butt) at the red sheet's split, x 211.12.

corrections.what: Traced the right-hand subject as the sheet draws it: a ribbed box (five bays, four ribs) with a short top handle, beside an L-shaped line whose short crossbar sits low on its vertical, with the arrow running off the L's top
corrections.why: The catalogue describes a rising bar chart and warns against a shipping box; the sheet shows this ribbed box and L-line instead. The image controls, and nothing is substituted.

corrections.what: Mirrored the building's upper part about x 67.85: finial, lantern, elliptical dome (rx 19.15, ry 17.18), drum, cornice, outer columns at 25.13 px out, three short pillars 12.5 px apart, base line
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. Measured axes run 67.6 to 68.05; the dome fits an ellipse at rms 0.06 px, which matches better than a circle (r 19.65, rms 0.17). Short pillars measure 55.5, 67.6 and 80.3.

corrections.what: Drew the drum's top as its own line overhanging both drum sides by about 1.2 px, with round ends
corrections.why: The sheet's drum top runs from ink 41.9 to 94.2 while the sides sit at 45.85 and 90.08.

corrections.what: Gave the ribbed box even bays (ribs 11.84 px apart) and centred its handle; dropped its foot to y 116
corrections.why: DR-03 equal repeats. Ribs measure 189.88, 201.44, 213.25 and 224.88 (gaps 11.56 to 11.81); none moves more than 0.4 px. The foot line's inner edge sits at y 113.2 and its ink at 118.75; the first line fit (115.64) was pulled up by the ribs.

corrections.what: Drew the ballot as a rectangle tilted 50 degrees with a right-angled top and a level bottom edge cut where it meets the slot line, corners at (101.78, 79.8), (117.5, 61.06), (126.31, 68.45) and (116.79, 79.8)
corrections.why: DR-03 right angles. Its long edges measure 50.3 and 49.6 degrees and the top edge 40.2 degrees; the bottom edge tilts 0.4 px. The sheet's ballot strokes run 4.3 to 5.0 px; at W its window is about 1 px smaller.

corrections.what: Gave the arrowhead two arms at 45 degrees, 12.4 px long, meeting at x 237.4
corrections.why: Row-by-row arm centres run at slopes 1.0 and 0.92; the first line fits (47 and 53 degrees) were pulled by the tip's junction.

corrections.what: Mirrored the ballot box's lid stubs at 61.1 degrees, tips at y 77.2, and gave the box's lower corners one radius, 3.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. The stubs measure 60.1 and 62.3 degrees; the left tip's cap reads 1.4 px wider to the right than the right tip's, a raster accident at one end only.

corrections.what: Levelled the ground and annex top lines and drew every stroke at W, 5.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03. The ground line tilts 0.23 px; the icon measures 5.25 px. The lantern's border measures 4.7 to 5.25 px, so at W its window is 0.3 px shorter than drawn but stays open.

notes: Kept: finial, lantern with its window, dome, drum, cornice, two outer columns and three short pillars, base line; the lower building's annex with its slot, two pillars and ground line, with its right side hidden behind the ballot box; the ballot box's open lid stubs; the ballot clear of the box; the L-line's crossbar; the ribbed box's four ribs and handle, with the handle stopping short of the arrow line. Sheet disagreement: catalogue versus red sheet on the ballot's red extent (see the first correction).
